title: A log analyzer
hints: Cut the line apart at its separators: `line.IndexOf(' ')`, `rest.IndexOf("] ")` and `rest.IndexOf(": ")` find them, and `Substring` takes the pieces between. `DateTime.TryParseExact(text, "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, styles, out var time)` with `DateTimeStyles.AdjustToUniversal | DateTimeStyles.AssumeUniversal` then turns the time into a UTC `DateTime` (and rejects dates like February 30).
Write a private `ReadFileAsync(path)` that returns one file's entries and its malformed count; `Task.WhenAll(paths.Select(ReadFileAsync))` then reads them all at the same time.
`[EnumeratorCancellation]` on the token parameter of an async iterator lets callers pass a token with `WithCancellation` as well as directly.
requirements: Read the files concurrently with `Task.WhenAll`, and each file line by line with a `StreamReader` inside an `async` iterator (`IAsyncEnumerable<LogEntry>`).
Pass the `CancellationToken` through to the file reads.
stretch: Add a `--follow` mode that keeps reading a file as new lines are appended, like `tail -f`.
